professionalSummary.text: Candidate has trained and evaluated intent classification and answer retrieval models for the support chat assistant using annotated conversation data and replay sets.
professionalSummary.witness: Trained and evaluated intent classification and answer retrieval models for the support chat assistant in the model development sandbox, using the annotated conversation corpus and a replay set of anonymised past conversations as the held-out evaluation data.

experienceHighlights.text: Candidate built and maintained an offline evaluation harness that scored candidate models on intent accuracy, retrieval recall, and replay-set regressions before release.
experienceHighlights.witness: Built and maintained the offline evaluation harness that scored every candidate model on intent accuracy, retrieval recall and replay-set regressions before it was proposed for release.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Candidate prepared release candidates for the assistant platform team, including model cards and release notes, and documented model limitations and hand-over conditions.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Wrote the model card and the release notes for each candidate model, listing the training data cut, the replay-set results and the known failure modes on multi-intent messages.

skills.text: Candidate has experience in model training, evaluation, release preparation, and documentation for conversational AI systems.
skills.witness: Over about two and a half years the work covered model training, the evaluation harness, release candidate preparation, model cards and release notes for the assistant's intent and retrieval models.

decisionBoundary.statement: The candidate's experience is partially aligned with the role's requirements, but key aspects such as model release and incident handling are not clearly established.
